description: Maps golf courses hole by hole: greens, fairways, tees, bunkers, water and the line of play, with the scorecard data (number, par, handicap) that golf apps read. A prototype.
highlights: Golf presets first in the type picker, bunkers with natural=sand and water hazards with natural=water
A golf map style: each part of the course in its colour, holes without number or par in amber
The holes as a scorecard in the dock: par, handicap, length, what is missing
Eight golf rules with fixes, roads and buildings locked by the filters
Drawing tools: right angles, rectangles, merge, cut, resize
